title: German Oat Pudding
description: A hearty German-inspired oat pudding recipe, perfect for a cold winter morning.

ingredients.name: rolled oats
ingredients.notes: old-fashioned or quick oats work well

ingredients.name: milk
ingredients.notes: dairy or non-dairy milk, such as almond milk

instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine oats, milk, beaten eggs, honey, vanilla extract, cinnamon, and salt. Cook over medium heat, whisking constantly, until mixture comes to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 5-7 minutes, or until oats have absorbed most of the liquid and the mixture has a creamy consistency.
Remove from heat and let cool slightly.
Transfer mixture to 2-3 individual baking dishes or ramekins.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the pudding is set and the top is lightly golden.
Serve warm or chilled, garnished with additional cinnamon or a drizzle of honey, if desired.
